answer_1.quote: WangchanThaiInstruct comprises 28,098 training and 6,916 test samples across four domains and seven task types (Brainstorming, Classification, Closed QA, Creative writing, Multiple choice, Open QA, and Summarization).
answer_1.outputs: instruction-following responses in Thai across multiple domains and task types

answer_2.quote: We study the robustness of existing metrics (i.e., BLEU and ROUGE-L) and our metrics compared to human preferences in Appendix A.

answer_3.quote: We utilize LLMs to assess both correctness for tasks with objective answers (e.g., QA tasks) and to assign a 1-10 rating based on the quality of reasoning or justification.

answer_4.quote: We sampled 1,200 examples uniformly across all domains and task types. Following previous works, we had annotators rank the outputs from worst to best, while LLMs produced numerical ratings.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to rank the outputs from worst to best based on quality, factuality, and relevance to the instruction.
